articleTitle: Google Opens Connected Apps Preview for Gemini and Search Services

sources.title: As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps
Google opens preview for third-party apps inside Search and Gemini - PPC Land

claims.claim: Google has introduced the Connected Apps Platform preview, giving businesses a unified path to bring software capabilities directly into Gemini and Google Search.
claims.bestSource: Google opens preview for third-party apps inside Search and Gemini - PPC Land
claims.evidence: "To help users get more done, today we're launching the preview of our Connected Apps Platform, a unified way for more app developers to bring their capabilities directly into Gemini and Search," according to the post.
claims.bestPassage: "To help users get more done, today we're launching the preview of our Connected Apps Platform, a unified way for more app developers to bring their capabilities directly into Gemini and Search," according to the post.

claims.claim: The company's goal is to allow any business or developer to reach users through these AI interfaces by submitting connected applications and monitoring their ongoing performance.
claims.bestSource: As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps
claims.evidence: Google’s idea is to open its doors to any business or developer that wants to reach users through Search or Gemini by allowing them to submit their own connected apps and monitor their performance.

claims.claim: Under this approach, a single build covers both Gemini and Search, allowing developers to choose whether an application appears in Search, the Gemini app, or across both environments.

claims.evidence: Developers can also choose whether they want their app to be available via Search, the Gemini app, or both.
